reason: AC1-AC9 are the completion checklist; AC9 (no chunking-strategy branching in embedder/store/worker) is verified by inspection only, so it must be checked deliberately.

Verify the single-commit boundary is actually implemented as designed: store.replace_chunks must not commit, and DELETE + INSERT + index_status=done must share one transaction. This is the whole basis of R2.
Verify claim_episode uses an atomic status-guarded UPDATE (no SELECT-then-UPDATE race) and that reset_stale_processing/reset_failed match the documented crash-recovery pattern.
Verify every openai/httpx failure is wrapped in EmbeddingError (no bare client exception escapes), and that a per-episode failure isolates to index_status=failed without killing the loop.
Data crosses transcript_data JSONB -> clean_words -> ChunkSpan -> embedding vector -> chunk row; check shape consistency at each handoff, especially the positional zip of spans against vectors.
